wins.text: FMI Technology signings reached 105 devices per day in Q1 2024, the first quarter ever exceeding the 100/day milestone, up from ~98/day average in 2023
Onsite active sites grew ~12% YoY with 102 signings in Q1, and customer expo attendance up 50% YoY with double the number of customers vs. last year, signaling strong pipeline momentum
Operating cash flow of $336 million in Q1 2024, representing 113% of net income conversion, with debt reduced to just 5.5% of total capital vs. 10.9% a year ago
Safety product sales grew 8.3% in Q1 2024, supported by strong FMI signings and healthy warehousing/fulfillment center demand
Gross margin down only 20 bps YoY to 45.5%, better than feared, with slightly positive price/cost and improved leverage on internal/external trucking resources as inventory rightsizing completed

risks.text: Total daily sales grew only 1.9% YoY in Q1 2024, well below management's ~4% expectation entering the quarter, driven by sluggish underlying industrial demand
Fastener product line revenue declined 4.4% YoY, reflecting weak OEM/MRO demand and negative pricing, particularly tied to foreign steel index softness
Operating margin contracted 60 bps YoY to 20.6%, with SG&A rising to 24.9% of sales due to 3.9% labor cost growth including substantially higher healthcare costs
Q2 2024 operating margins expected to face an additional ~30 bps headwind from expanded customer expo costs and near-term investments to service new large customers at scale
Western U.S. business unit posted negative growth in Q1 while Eastern U.S. was positive, with Onsite signings skewed toward Eastern U.S., highlighting uneven execution post-reorganization

guidance_items.detail: Full-year net capital spending reaffirmed at $225M–$245M, up from $161M in 2023, driven by hub automation, Utah DC upgrade, FMI spend, and IT
Q2 2024 operating margins expected to face ~30 bps incremental headwind from customer expo expansion and new customer service investments; not expected to carry into subsequent quarters
Full-year gross margin cadence unchanged; gross margin expected to be down modestly in 2024 but less than historical drag periods, consistent with Q1's 20 bps decline

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Impact of potential future tariffs on Fastenal's supply chain and pricing execution
Geographic performance divergence between Eastern and Western U.S. business units and internal organizational friction post-restructuring
Historical contribution of branch closures to Onsite growth and sustainability of Onsite signings without that tailwind
